rows.name: American Victory Amateur Radio Club
rows.notes: Operates special event stations from the SS American Victory museum ship in downtown Tampa. Site is http only — it has no working HTTPS certificate, so browsers will flag it as not secure.

rows.name: Brandon Amateur Radio Society (BARS)
rows.notes: Focused on public service communications for east Tampa.

rows.name: Clearwater Amateur Radio Society (CARS)
rows.notes: Meets at the Clearwater Fire Training Facility. Operates local repeater systems.

rows.name: Upper Pinellas Amateur Radio Club (UPARC)
rows.notes: Serves the north county area around Palm Harbor and Tarpon Springs. Active in POTA.
